sourceState: Gallery keeps the complete original local Active Theory runtime, 31 project cards, authored assets, shaders, damping, scroll camera, hover behavior, click navigation, and detail views. The original SpineInstancer is hidden. The Demo Host Cortana renderer stays fixed above the runtime, faces the camera with the same default orientation as Home, and continuously plays only idle.catwalk. Gallery interactions pass through to the original cards and do not change the Cortana action.
